current.title: Wake County Student Petitions for Fair AI Detection Policies After False Cheating Accusation
current.summary: A North Carolina high school freshman launched a Change.org petition after AI detection tools flagged her original writing as 87% AI-generated, sparking a national debate over the accuracy and fairness of AI plagiarism detectors in K-12 classrooms.

current.title: 31 States Introduce 134 AI Education Bills in Record 2026 Legislative Push
current.summary: A new tracking report reveals that 134 AI-in-education bills have been introduced across 31 states this legislative session, covering student data privacy, classroom use restrictions, and mandatory AI literacy curriculum requirements.

current.title: AI Literacy Added to 2029 PISA Global Student Assessment for the First Time
current.summary: The international PISA exam will measure AI literacy among 15-year-olds worldwide for the first time in 2029, pushing policymakers to accelerate AI education standards so students can compete on a global stage.

archives.title: Khan Academy Expands Khanmigo AI Tutor to All Free Users
archives.summary: Khan Academy is rolling out its GPT-4 powered tutoring assistant Khanmigo to all users at no cost, marking a major shift in free AI-powered education.

archives.title: UNESCO Releases Global Framework for AI Literacy in Schools
archives.summary: UNESCO published a new framework recommending that all students aged 10 and up receive foundational AI literacy education by 2027.

archives.title: Study: Students Who Learn AI Concepts Early Score Higher in STEM
archives.summary: A new Stanford study found that middle schoolers introduced to AI concepts showed a 23% improvement in computational thinking scores compared to control groups.

archives.title: Google Releases Free AI Essentials Course for K-12 Teachers
archives.summary: Google launched a self-paced AI Essentials curriculum specifically designed for K-12 educators, covering AI basics, ethics, and classroom integration.

archives.title: EU Mandates AI Education in All Member State Curricula by 2028
archives.summary: The European Union passed legislation requiring AI literacy to be part of the official school curriculum across all 27 member states within two years.

archives.title: Microsoft Partners with 500 School Districts for AI Literacy Push
archives.summary: Microsoft announced a partnership with over 500 US school districts to provide free AI literacy tools and teacher training through its Education suite.
